maddeler.e:
أضطغن (form VIII)
# أَضْطَغِنُ (ʔaḍṭaḡinu) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ɣi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# أُضْطَغَنُ (ʔuḍṭaḡanu) /ʔudˤ.tˤa.ɣa.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# أَضْطَغِنَ (ʔaḍṭaḡina) /ʔadˤ.tˤa.ɣi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# أُضْطَغَنَ (ʔuḍṭaḡana) /ʔud
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
